purpose: 同原正文换行来源修正，初粘连错误输出保留；执行前保存完整程序
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal
import json, csv, hashlib, re
ROOT=Path.cwd()
REL='reports/research/510300_enterprise_turnover_composition_cause_description_v1'
OUT=ROOT/REL
SRC='reports/research/510300_enterprise_working_capital_source_v1'
def now(): return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def load(rel): return json.loads((ROOT/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save_new(name,obj):
    p=OUT/name
    assert not p.exists(),'既有事实不覆盖：'+name
    p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
protocol=load(REL+'/protocol.json')
assert protocol['experiment_id']=='E86'
save_new('同原文字层换行修正登记.json',{'at':now(),'purpose':'移除全部空白使图表轴数字与叙述百分数粘连，保留原换行并只读同一当前正文问题','initial_outputs_preserved':True,'revision':'v1_0_1','new_sources':0,'new_fits':0,'labels_read':0,'numeric_imputation':False})
for receipt in protocol['input_receipts']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/receipt['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==receipt['sha256'],'登记原输入变化'
final=load(SRC+'/全部29当前资金周转值与方法_同原标点修正_v1_0_1.json')
raw=load(SRC+'/全部29企业家原全文与当前周转字段_自动原输出.json')
manual=load(SRC+'/同一2020Q4原页目视数值及方法.json')
source_gate=load(SRC+'/source_gate_v1_0_1.json')
early_gate=load('reports/research/510300_enterprise_2021q1_original_vintage_probe_v1/result.json')
assert not source_gate['source_gate_passed'] and not early_gate['different_early_original_located']
assert len(final['targets'])==29 and len(raw['all_original_pages_full_text'])==29
rawmap={r['quarter']:r for r in raw['all_original_pages_full_text']}
rows=[]
snippets=[]
for t in final['targets']:
    quarter=t['quarter']
    rr=rawmap[quarter]
    assert rr['pdf']['sha256']==t['pdf']['sha256']
    page_records=rr['all_original_pages_full_text']
    whole='\n'.join(p['full_text'] for p in page_records)
    compact=whole
    starts=list(re.finditer(r'资\s*金\s*周\s*转\s*指\s*数\s*为',compact))
    candidates={'good':[],'normal':[],'difficult':[]}
    snippet=''
    method='CURRENT_ORIGINAL_TEXT'
    page_numbers=[p['pdf_page_1based'] for p in page_records if '资金周转指数为' in re.sub(r'\s+','',p['full_text'])]
    if quarter=='2020Q4':
        assert manual['original_pdf']['sha256']==t['pdf']['sha256']
        good=manual['current_good_percent']
        normal=manual['current_general_percent']
        difficult=manual['current_difficult_percent']
        candidates={'good':[str(good)],'normal':[str(normal)],'difficult':[str(difficult)]}
        method='SAME_ORIGINAL_PREVIOUSLY_VISUALLY_READ_CURRENT_BODY'
        page_numbers=[2]
        snippet='本季资金周转59.3%；良好32.8%、一般53.0%、困难14.2%；同一原PDF第2页已目视，重复字文字层保留。'
    elif len(starts)==1:
        start=starts[0].start()
        stop_match=re.search(r'销\s*货\s*款\s*回\s*笼\s*指\s*数\s*为',compact[starts[0].end():])
        stop=starts[0].end()+stop_match.start() if stop_match else -1
        if stop>=0:
            snippet=compact[start:stop]
            candidates['good']=re.findall(r'其\s*中\s*[，,]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%',snippet)
            candidates['normal']=re.findall(r'(?<![\d.])(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%\s*认\s*为\s*[“"]\s*一\s*般\s*[”"]',snippet)
            candidates['difficult']=re.findall(r'(?<![\d.])(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%[^%]{0,150}?认\s*为\s*[“"]\s*困\s*难\s*[”"]',snippet)
        good=float(candidates['good'][0]) if len(candidates['good'])==1 else None
        normal=float(candidates['normal'][0]) if len(candidates['normal'])==1 else None
        difficult=float(candidates['difficult'][0]) if len(candidates['difficult'])==1 else None
    else:
        good=normal=difficult=None
    index=t['current_value_percent']
    finite=all(v is not None and 0<=v<=100 for v in [good,normal,difficult,index])
    residual=mass_residual=None
    if finite:
        residual=Decimal(str(index))-Decimal(str(good))-Decimal('0.5')*Decimal(str(normal))
        mass_residual=Decimal(str(good))+Decimal(str(normal))+Decimal(str(difficult))-Decimal('100')
    qualified=bool(finite and abs(residual)<=Decimal('0.125') and abs(mass_residual)<=Decimal('0.15'))
    rows.append({'quarter':quarter,'original_index_percent':index,
        'good_percent':good if good is not None else 'UNKNOWN',
        'normal_percent':normal if normal is not None else 'UNKNOWN',
        'difficult_percent':difficult if difficult is not None else 'UNKNOWN',
        'three_shares_sum_percent':float(Decimal(str(good))+Decimal(str(normal))+Decimal(str(difficult))) if finite else 'UNKNOWN',
        'index_minus_good_plus_half_normal_pp':float(residual) if residual is not None else 'UNKNOWN',
        'sum_minus_100_pp':float(mass_residual) if mass_residual is not None else 'UNKNOWN',
        'composition_read_qualified':qualified,'original_display':t['original_publication_display'],
        'known_later_current_pdf_than_display':t['known_later_file_than_displayed_original_release'],
        'E84_historical_source_qualified':t['source_gate_qualified'],
        'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,
        'original_pdf':t['pdf']['path'],'original_pdf_sha256':t['pdf']['sha256'],
        'current_original_body_pdf_pages':page_numbers,'read_method':method})
    snippets.append({'quarter':quarter,'current_original_section':snippet,'candidate_values':candidates,
        'index_current_body_start_count':len(starts),'original_pdf':t['pdf'],'qualified':qualified})
assert len(rows)==29
save_new('全部29原当前周转问题构成及提取段_v1_0_1.json',{'rows':rows,'original_current_question_snippets':snippets,'missing_not_imputed':True,'source_gate_unchanged':True})
p=OUT/'全部29原当前问题构成_未知保留_v1_0_1.csv'
assert not p.exists()
with p.open('w',encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(rows[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
groups=defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    groups[str(r['original_index_percent'])].append(r)
same_groups=[]
for index,members in sorted(groups.items(),key=lambda kv:float(kv[0])):
    if len(members)<2:
        continue
    complete=all(r['composition_read_qualified'] for r in members)
    ranges={}
    for col in ['good_percent','normal_percent','difficult_percent']:
        ranges[col]=float(Decimal(str(max(r[col] for r in members)))-Decimal(str(min(r[col] for r in members)))) if complete else 'UNKNOWN'
    same_groups.append({'same_printed_index_percent':float(index),'members':members,
        'all_compositions_read_qualified':complete,'ranges_pp':ranges,
        'different_composition_under_same_printed_index':bool(complete and any(v>0.1 for v in ranges.values())),
        'same_enterprises_responding_across_quarters_authenticated':False,
        'economic_cause_identified':False,'stock_direction_tested':False})
save_new('全部同印刷指数分组_不选年份_v1_0_1.json',{'groups':same_groups,'all_groups_retained':True,
    'printed_equality_not_exact_unrounded_equality':True,'stock_labels_used':0})
evidence_groups=[g for g in same_groups if g['different_composition_under_same_printed_index']]
accepted=bool(evidence_groups)
results={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E86','completed_at':now(),
    'status':'SUPPORTED_CURRENT_ORIGINAL_INDEX_COMPOSITION_NOT_UNIQUE_WITH_CAUSAL_LIMITS' if accepted else 'COMPLETED_CURRENT_QUESTION_COMPOSITION_DISCOVERY_WITHOUT_ACCEPTED_NONUNIQUENESS_EVIDENCE',
    'current_original_quarters':len(rows),'composition_read_qualified':sum(r['composition_read_qualified'] for r in rows),
    'unknown_or_inconsistent_quarters':[r['quarter'] for r in rows if not r['composition_read_qualified']],
    'all_repeated_printed_index_groups':len(same_groups),'different_composition_groups':len(evidence_groups),
    'index_cannot_uniquely_identify_response_composition_supported':accepted,
    'causal_adjustment_reason_identified':False,
    'source_actual_math':'I=良好+0.5×一般；未舍入份额合計100时I=50+0.5×(良好−困难)，一个总数不能分别识别良好/困难占比。',
    'mechanism_limits':[
        '资金周转为企业本季主观压力感受，不是现金余额、实际贷款需求、融资供给冲击或权益净买盘。',
        '困难占比和良好占比的份额变化是指数构成，不等于资金变化背后的经济原因。',
        '原问题不能区分回款改善、银行或供应商融资、支付减少、投资缩减或被调查企业构成变化。',
        '相同印刷指数分组为来源描述；不同季度不是同一控制组，不认证相同企业回答或精确未舍入总指数相同。',
        '2021Q1当前PDF晚于显示发布的问题及真正历史首版未知保持；未进行有提前可知保证的收益检验。'],
    'E84_source_gate_still_passed':False,'E85_route_no_distinct_early_original':True,
    'new_network_queries':0,'new_HTTP_GETs':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
    'financial_model':'NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED',
    'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,
    'old_financial_rejections_preserved':True,'goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
    'root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0}
results['same_original_extraction_revision']='v1_0_1_keep_original_line_boundaries'
results['initial_axis_digit_concatenation_errors_preserved']=True
save_new('result_v1_0_1.json',results)
lines=['# 企业资金周转：原回答构成与原因识别限制','',
    'E86只读已有29份当前原企业家报告；不读股票标签、不拟合、不联网、不改源码。它回答指数的含义与识别局限，不能用于宣称策略有效。','',
    '## 实际原字段与数学事实','',
    '原问卷按本季周转良好份额×1、一般份额×0.5、困难份额×0计算。份额未舍入且合计100时，指数等于50+0.5×(良好−困难)。因此同一个指数不能分别确定良好和困难占比。原显示一位小数，以下只比较全部相同印刷值，不声称未舍入值精确相等。','',
    f'全部29条均保留；构成读数及舍入一致性通过{results["composition_read_qualified"]}条，未知或不一致{len(results["unknown_or_inconsistent_quarters"])}条。全部相同印刷值分组{len(same_groups)}组，其中{len(evidence_groups)}组有超过原0.1pp份额显示精度的构成差异。','',
    '| 原经济季度 | 周转指数 | 良好占比 | 一般占比 | 困难占比 | 原当前载体时钟限制 |',
    '|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|']
for r in rows:
    lines.append(f'| {r["quarter"]} | {r["original_index_percent"]} | {r["good_percent"]} | {r["normal_percent"]} | {r["difficult_percent"]} | '+('已知晚于页面公布；不回填历史可知' if r['known_later_current_pdf_than_display'] else '首版未认证；当前载体描述')+' |')
lines+=['','## 全部同值分组','']
for g in same_groups:
    lines.append(f'- 印刷指数{g["same_printed_index_percent"]}：'+ '、'.join(r['quarter'] for r in g['members'])+
        f'；良好/一般/困难占比跨度{g["ranges_pp"]["good_percent"]}/{g["ranges_pp"]["normal_percent"]}/{g["ranges_pp"]["difficult_percent"]}pp。')
lines+=['','## 对经济原因的裁决','',
    '接受“单一扩散指数不能唯一识别企业压力构成”的原问题和数学证据；不接受“已确定股市方向”或“已查明周转调整的原因”。同指数下困难占比不同，说明需要识别压力在哪些企业；这仍不能证明银行融资供给、回款、库存、投入支出或企业样本变动各自造成多少变化。','',
    '企业资金周转与销货款回笼即使共同变动，也是共同主观回答，不能自行成为外生原因。适合继续核查的是不同的实际回款/占款数量或时间信息及其原统计口径、发布时间、旧用途；未核实连续数据、来源版本及不同金融用途之前，不登记新增金融模型。','',
    '## 保留的失败与限制','','初次移除全部空白导致图表轴数字粘连正文百分数，5条误判未知；原输出保留。本修正仅保留同原全文换行读取对应标签，不补值、不读股票标签或换源。','',
    'E84完整来源门仍未通过；2021Q1当前原PDF晚于2021-03-25显示发布日期，E85登记的四查询早版路线没有找到合格不同原载体。29当前原数值可作上述描述，不能借本次组成研究把来源门改为通过。旧银行需求与审批金融拒绝、重复比较和错误判定完整保留。','',
    '本轮网络/新股票标签/拟合/账户/源码修改均0；净夏普NOT_COMPUTED，完整目标未达；NO_VIEW、仓位UNSET。']
report=OUT/'企业资金周转_构成与原因识别限制_同原换行修正.md'
assert not report.exists()
report.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'实验':'E86原问题构成与原因识别限制','状态':results['status'],
    '完整构成条数':results['composition_read_qualified'],'未知季度':results['unknown_or_inconsistent_quarters'],
    '全部同印刷指数分组':len(same_groups),'构成不同分组':len(evidence_groups),
    '57.8原构成':[{'季度':r['quarter'],'良好':r['good_percent'],'一般':r['normal_percent'],'困难':r['difficult_percent']} for r in rows if r['original_index_percent']==57.8],
    '金融及目标':'未检验、未达'},ensure_ascii=False))
